article.title: Two years after launch, Walmart’s Flipkart is closing in on India’s quick-commerce leaders
article.description: Flipkart's quick-commerce venture is delivering 1.1 million to 1.2 million orders a day, nearly triple its November volume.

generated.caption:
Imagine millions of daily deliveries arriving at your door!

Walmart's Flipkart is rapidly expanding its quick-commerce service in India. Just two years after launch, they're now fulfilling over 1.1 million orders daily – nearly triple their November volume! This massive growth highlights the speed of modern e-commerce.
